tool_args.rationale: The source archive identifies a gradient-suppressed saturating siphon response with an unresolved square-root branch versus linear leak. Fit those three stated alternatives numerically to all seven observations and select the lowest-residual mechanism. No further probe is justified by the available evidence.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the H=14 row is consistent with a static response once its low u_now and high sink gradient are considered.
Already acquired; its observation is included in the branch-family fit.
The seven observations plus explicit source mechanism note support a static siphon family; an RK4 four-parameter memory fit requires more rows and is not presently the leading explanation.
The source notes explicitly indicate a branch/leak contribution and the open-branch probe was acquired to resolve this possibility.
The data do not show sign reversal, and the long-horizon observation is positive.
